name: Fran Borsellino
text: The Owner is very accommodating, inviting and makes beautiful drinks paring fabulous entrées!

name: Vivian Hua
text:
Cozy little restaurant. Excellent food and excellent drinks. Great service. We would be back again - everything was so delicious.

We were also able to get a table pretty last minute on a Friday night, which is a great bonus! It was flexible for us since we didn’t know what time we’d get to Brantford

name: Carolyn Cain
text: This was my first time. A friend and I shared a bunch of things so we could try many dishes. We had the whipped feta, shrimp tacos and pork belly to start. Everything was amazing. We also shared the beef tenderloin which was cooked to perfection! The place is quaint and comfortable. Shout out to Charlotte for the amazing service and suggestions 🙌. We will definitely be back again and again!!

name: Sam Andrews
text: One of the best meals I have ever had in a long time, I highly recommend coming here! From start to finish our sever was checking in and even part of the meal was perfect!

name: Allisa Andrews
text: Incredible food, incredible service, we will absolutely be back! Thank you so much for making our anniversary special 🥰

name: Andy Battler
text: This is a favourite of ours. The quality is amazing, and the prices are reasonable relative to the quality.

name: April Morganti
text: Food was good, but for the price I expected better.

name: Diana Barber
text: I've been wanting to come to this restaurant awhile and finally made it tonight! The food was amazing. My husband and I had the 3 course meal and every plate was delicious. My husband started with ceviche, then steak with risotto before finishing with a cheesecake.  I started with their beets, followed by salmon with risotto and ended with creme brulee. Everything was perfect! My husband recently found out he is celiac and has been struggling with limited restaurant options. But he was thrilled that fume has so many options. We can't wait to come back!

name: Ross Draper
text: Food was incredible,  service was excellent. Friendly staff, top notch food and a great atmosphere. Would easily recommend this establishment. A must try if you are in the area.

name: Natasha Bond
text: Everything was on point and delicious, I will be back and have told many people to get to Fume

name: Chris A
text: Everything about this place was enjoyable. The wonderful service, the delicious food, the Reggae music, a great vibe altogether. What a find after riding all day on the scooter.

name: Shanel J
text: Everything was great!! Service was awesome and of course the food and drinks were amazing! Highly recommend!

name: Michelle Miller
text: Incredible dining experience. Food is incredible and atmosphere is intimate

name: Susan Karmann
text: Very disappointing birthday dinner. My daughter and her boyfriend brought me here to celebrate my 67th birthday, and the experience fell far short of expectations. The service was incredibly slow., we waited a long time anfter being seated and even longer for our drinks. The appetizer was mediocre, and my main course arrived lukewarm. Spending nearly $200, we expected much better food and service. Unfortunately, this was not the special birthday dinner we had hoped for.

name: Justin Messervey
text: This place is what the young folks call “bussin”… food was absolutely fantastic and the service was even better. The atmosphere is perfect. Highly recommend!

name: Stephen Hughes
text: Great place for dinner. Staff where all top notch. Very impressed

name: nicole taylor
text: Always have a good meal when I come here. I love the Greek fusion cuisine that they have.  Only complaint is parking can be annoying.

name: Lesli Q
text: we LOVED this place. the ambiance was lovely, our server (Billy) was a delight. we shared the beet salad & added chicken. it was perfect because we weren't very hungry. oh and the hot honey & sourdough bread along with that. divine! I live 2+ hrs away but would definitely drive back for a meal here. there weren't a lot of options for a mostly vegetarian but still worth it. the bourbon smash cocktail & dill pickle caesar were also yummy.

name: Suzanne Grundy
text: Definitely going back.

name: paolo gatti
text: Ristorante e bar piacevole, ambiente tranquillo e personale cordiale. I piatti proposti sono curati e buoni. Lo suggerisco

name: Ashley Bos
text: Great food and wine! We will be back here

name: Cynthia Levac
text:
We recently had the pleasure of dining at Fume RestoBar, in Brantford and it was truly an exceptional experience from start to finish.

While I don’t often write reviews, this visit certainly warranted recognition. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by a friendly and attentive hostess. The service throughout the evening was impeccable—our wait staff were both professional and genuinely engaging, contributing to a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

The culinary experience itself was outstanding. Each dish was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented, showcasing both creativity and quality.

The desserts deserve special mention—the Crème Brûlée and cheesecake were absolutely outstanding and provided the perfect ending to an already remarkable meal.

A particularly memorable touch was the owner, Ted, taking the time to visit our table personally to ensure we were enjoying our meal. This level of care and attention to guests truly sets this establishment apart.

Overall, our dining experience was second to none. I would highly recommend Fume RestoBar to anyone seeking exceptional food, service, and hospitality.

name: Charlton C
text:
I don’t usually do reviews but really enjoyed this spot!

The service and atmosphere was fantastic, the food was excellent and they really take pride in the flavours.

Loved this place.

name: Patrick Hart
text: Great music, great food, great service.  They due gluten free with excellence.

name: Erick Sta. Maria
text: Amazing food, amazing service. My only "tiny" complaint that it was really smokey. I'll definitely be going back ☺️🙏🏽

name: B Geffros
text: Hope you like cheap balsamic glaze

name: Rajesh Bale
text: Nice food and ambiance!

name: Dylan Mccue
text:
Been here a couple times and it's always been consistent.
The food is the star of this place, the menu has something for everyone. The plating is pretty, especially if you get take out. Would highly recommend this place if you're a foodie to any degree.
When it comes to drinks they can be a hit or miss. The house beer is hella fine, and would recommend. Tom Collins, Negroni are safe options. I would steer from the espresso martini. Flat, tasteless, the worst I've had ( I've had too many to count ).
Overall atmosphere is very friendly, and casual. Could come here for a really good date, or a meet up with friends.
Service is good, for the most part. Let us stay 20 minutes past close, so that's solid.
5 stars, will still come back for the great parts.

name: Giovanni Petitti
text:
Great place for lunch or dinner.
Excellent drink menu helpful and friendly staff. Excellent food.

name: Danny Vandermeer
text: If you are looking for a place that has gluten free options on there menu in Brantford. You got to check this place out! Great food, nice atmosphere. Reservation recommended.

name: Chris Lichach
text: First time here, and everything was excellent. I had the shrimp tacos, a nice COLD glass of Pino Grigio, and a cappuccino. Tacos were perfectly seasoned, shrimp was delicious, perfectly cooked. I was so impressed with the dish, would definitely recommend this dish, and we will be back.. well worth the drive!! Everything was EXCELLENT!

name: Tim N
text: The food was absolutely incredible. I was very impressed and I’ll definitely be back. The service was great too.

name: Giuseppe C.
text: Locale un po’ vecchio ma cibo e servizio veramente buoni. Ottimi i tacos e il salmone affumicato. Un po’ caro ma ne vale la pena

name: Mars Docrat
text: Brantfords little hidden gem for sure ! Had my Valentine’s Day dinner here I had the Duck Breast and my partner had the Chicken Souvlaki. The Duck was PHENOMENAL!! Not everyone can get duck right and this place had absolutely delicious duck the potatoes where under cooked a bit but it was still very tasty . The Chicken souvlaki was also amazing pita was great Greek salad chefs kiss. Definitely will be back ! Prices were actually very good. Our waitress wasn’t the best with service but we still enjoyed our time together !

name: Lucas Jancar
text: Terrible experience not worth the price. First of all, I ordered takeout that I picked up so I understand that food may not be perfect after the 5 minute drive home. However, this was absolutely horrendous. The fries, dropped in that deep fryer numerous times, dark, lifeless, soggy, and cold (I understand fries get soggy quick when ordering takeout/deliver but this was not just abnormally soggy, but also cold to the touch while other items were warm/hot). Also did you guys put raw garlic on every item, including the coleslaw? or are you just cutting all of your items with dirty garlic knives!? The tartar had awful flavor that I dont even know how to describe was achieved, as well as the crustini that came with it was more stale than the atmosphere of the resturant. The chicken burger, is that coated in nutmeg or something before being fried? The seasoning was atrocious. The only good peice I have to say is that the fish and chips came with some big slices of fish. 3 items for 100 dollars and I'd rather have paid to lick the bottom of my shoe :)

name: Chris Leabeter
text:
My wife and I LOVE LOVE LOVE this place!
Sure, we might be biased because it's a short walk from our house and we can stumble home, but in all seriousness it's because we CONSISTENTLY leave this place full and with a smile on our face.
The food is always so great, the portions are generous for the price, and we always have great servers who have some character and are willing to have a laugh with us.
This is our go-to restaurant when friends come to visit and we pop by for impromptu meals when we're feeling too lazy to cook.
The burgers are always awesome, and the BEETS! salad is so friggin' good that we order it every time. I'd recommend the Toblerone cheesecake, but that means there's less likelihood there will be pieces available for us the next time we go.... so back off!
I recommend this place to everybody who hasn't already discovered this hidden gem in Holmedale.
We'll be back, without a doubt.

name: Lana Bk
text: I've been going to FUME for years. Not sure what keeps me coming back- the patio in the summer, wide variety of drinks at the bar during the winter, or top notch staff. Food here is like dinning in Toronto. 10/10 chef's kiss, highly recommend for date night, girl's night out always a great eat.

name: phrrmnn
text:
My wife and I have been to fume several times and we have enjoyed some good meals while there. However, after last night, I left feeling let down.
Being somewhat familiar with the menu, we had already made up our minds what we were going to have before we even got there. I had a hamburger and fries and my wife decided she was going to have fish and chips. We also thought we would start with a Saganaki as she would end the meal with Toberlone cheesecake. For me, the whole meal lacked imagination and i left feeling like I didn’t get the best value for my money.
First off, I decided to have what they called their anniversary hamburger which was supposed to have been a nod to the owner’s Greek origins. When I heard that one of the specials was a feta burger, I was excited. Having been to Greece before, and the fact that I make my own feta burgers at home I thought this would be a real treat. What arrived was anything but.
First of all the feta wasn’t in the burger, but rather on the burger in two big pieces. Not only would it have been better had the feta actually been in the burger, but putting it on the burger, just made it a mess to try and eat. Note to the chef, mixing the feta in the burger, takes away some of the saltiness and leaves the cheese nice and creamy. Otherwise it was a rather bland burger. The truffle fries were just okay. The other disappointment was the Saginaki. It’s not unusual to put a light dusting of flour when making this delicious appetizer. However, for some reason they breaded the cheese, which in my mind absolutely ruined it. My wife had the fish and chips which she enjoyed.

I realize that times are tough for restaurants, but I couldn’t get over the cost of a glass of wine at $20 for a 9 ounce glass of Ripasso. My wife had a couple of blueberry teas and I had a Manhattan to start the meal. I was quite surprised that the cost for fish and chips, hamburger and fries with a few drinks would be $188 before tip. In total, a $230 meal, including tip.
The one thing I took away from this experience is that it is just not worth going out anymore to have dinner. The costs are almost extortionate and the quality and creativity just isn’t there anymore. Sadly, good places in Brantford are becoming few and far between. Hopefully you’ll feel differently when you visit Fume

name: Scott Besco
text: Excellent experience last night at Fume Restobar. The atmosphere was welcoming, and the service was outstanding. Ashley, our server, was friendly, attentive, and very professional. She really made the evening enjoyable. The food was top-notch. The chicken Slovakia with salad was flavourful and perfectly cooked, and the chicken sandwich was just as good - fresh, juicy, and well put together. As a local business owner just down the street, it’s great to have a restaurant like this in the neighborhood. Highly recommended and we will definitely be back!

name: Susan Campbell
text:
The best meal I’ve had in Brantford since moving here. The food, the service, everything was on point
THE most amazing beet salad and the scallops…oh the scallops, they were so good with the risotto. Can’t stop thinking about when I’m going back.

name: Steve Authier
text: Great find. I drove in from Hamilton for dinner with friends. My seafood pasta was excellent. It was listed on the menu as a rose sauce. I asked if the chef could prepare with an olive oil base sauce instead. They happily agreed. That was my first indication it would be a good meal. Often, chefs will decline to adjust their menu. It was phenomenal.

name: Ted West
text: Best food

name: Nadia Levitkaia
text: Our company Christmas lunch was there,  very delicious variety and all details were taken care. I love the place

name: G T
text:
This is definitely a hidden gem in Brantford. Nested in a cozy residential area you wouldn't expect an extraordinary culinary experience. I had the Chicken Souvlaki and it was beyond the expectations. The plate was carefully designed and flavour combination was to the point. The pita bread was cooked in house with a delicious olive oil.
Service was Ok but a bit too slow. Perhaps because there was a big table with 20+ guests.

name: A
text: Absolutely amazing!
